selection_tie_break: mean number of leaves, number of trees, candidate ID
tree_candidate_policy: Select final pruned tree among positive alpha values; retain alpha=0 as unpruned control.
preprocessing: No scaling, imputation or learned feature selection; seven raw finite numeric features.
duplicates_policy: Stop before split if duplicate feature vectors or invalid geometry exist; review before experiments.
test_policy: Freeze candidates, selected model, configuration and artifacts using development CV only; one final test batch.
